mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a current temperature of 55 degrees. Under a waxing gibbous moon, temperatures will dip to 51 degrees overnight, and there is no rain in the forecast.

City engineering reports are available for public review through the city website, and residents should prepare for the fall leaf collection season starting October 5, ensuring all loose leaves are behind the curb.

You have plenty of local options to enjoy, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow, followed by the popular Verona Fall Fest and live music at Bailey's Run on September 25.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 5, officers responded to a series of reports involving pranksters leaving cheese on vehicle windshields in several neighborhoods.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you when we reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM with a new flavor of the day.
